Definition: Does the government maintain a digital business register?
Comments: Digital business registry services exist: the Fichier National RCCM provides online search/consultation of official company documents; additional online services exist for RCCM acts and beneficial ownership register (RBE).

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: Electoral register exists with biometric voter registration introduced in 2012; lists published and consultable (at least via CENI website/posted lists), but not clearly a full online searchable register.
